model: Rolly Polly Frame and Fork Set
description:
PRE-ORDERS EXPECTED TO SHIP DECEMBER 2026!! New colors including Salted Milk Foam (white with chunky chrome fleck) and Purple Haze (a metallic purple blue hybrid).
After a ton of requests, we’re finally offering the heart of the Rolly Polly on its own. This listing is for the Rolly Polly frame and fork only giving you a clean slate to build it exactly how you want. The frame is built from custom triple-butted 4130 chromoly tubing, paired with a stiffer UDH hanger for snappier shifting and beefy thru-axle dropouts. It’s tough enough to pass ISO mountain bike standards, yet still cute enough to turn heads.
True to our design roots, the Rolly Polly keeps things simple and durable: no carbon forks, no internal cable nightmares… just a fun-first platform that’s easy to wrench and ready to rip. With a slightly longer seat tube for taller riders, a tweaked wheelbase for more playful handling, and our signature SWAG (small wheel adjusted geometry), this frame is built for underbiking with maximum style.
Whether you’re building a daily ripper, a travel companion, or a chaos-causing crew bike, the Rolly Polly frame & fork gives you the freedom to build it your way. Let’s see how far you can push this adorable little monster.
One size fits most (5’2” to 6’3”). Our frame geometry grows as you raise your seat height. This allows for a full range of rider sizes just by adjusting saddle height. (Standover height is 698mm or 27.5” from the ground. Top tube length is 545mm. Seat tube length is 440mm.)

100% 4130 triple-butted chromoly

BMX integrated headtube IS42/IS42 - Campy 45/45 deg size bearings

Water bottle mounts, rack mounts, fender mounts

Standard 68mm BSA threaded bottom bracket

34.9 seat clamp diameter, 31.6 size seatpost and dropper post ready cable routing

Fork Steer tube length is 375mm uncut

Proudly manufactured in Taiwan designed in Austin, TX
Our raw metal frames are finished with a light clear coat to show off the material, but they will rust and develop patina over time. It’s a lived-in look that show cases our welds that we love. If rust isn’t your thing, we recommend choosing a painted frame instead, since raw finishes aren’t for everyone (and that’s okay!)
USA domestic shipping to the lower 48 states is a flat rate of $50.00
